title: Concept: NuGet package pinned with a wildcard
description: packages.config declares a `N.N.*` wildcard pin, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The wildcard accepts every patch the feed publishes, so a package added after review installs without a manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: The wildcard accepts every patch the feed publishes, so a package added after review installs without a manifest change.
